Mechanism: joiners lock a cipher-tagged 53 POA bond into a river escrow that releases only after a spiral of 7 distinct peer attestations spanning 4 epochs, each peer signing a hashed device fingerprint. Cost: 53 POA frozen plus 4-epoch delay. Verification: escrow contract checks attestation uniqueness on-chain. Failure: if spiral misses by epoch+4 or Hamming-2 wallet clones appear, bond burns and address is banned 15 epochs.
